warnings.heading: FIRST CATEGORY WARNING ON STRONG WINDS AND ROUGH SEAS
warnings.text: SECTION A: FOR MALAYSIAN WATERS [WITHIN 24 NAUTICAL MILES] 1) THUNDERSTORMS WARNING Thunderstorms, heavy rain and strong winds are expected over the waters of Perlis & Kedah • Penang • Perak • Selangor • East Johor • Pahang • Terengganu • Kelantan • Sarawak • Eastern Sabah • Lahad Datu until 6:00 AM; Monday, 9 November 2026. This condition may cause strong winds up to 50 kmph and rough seas with wave height up to 3.5 metres and is dangerous to small boats. SECTION B: FOR SHIPPING 1) WARNING ON STRONG WINDS AND ROUGH SEAS (FIRST CATEGORY) Strong northeasterly winds of 40 - 50 kmph with wave height up to 3.5 metres are expected over the waters of Condore • Reef North until Tuesday, 10 November 2026. This condition of strong winds and rough seas is dangerous to small crafts, recreational sea activities and water sports. 2) THUNDERSTORMS WARNING Thunderstorms, heavy rain and strong winds are expected over the waters of Straits Of Melaka • Tioman • Samui • Bunguran • Western part of Condore • Sulu • Reef South • Sulawesi • Eastern part of Phuket until 6:00 AM; Monday, 9 November 2026. This condition may cause strong winds up to 50 kmph and rough seas with wave height up to 3.5 metres and is dangerous to small boats.
